description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Variable Installments feature within the Fineract platform. It primarily tests creation, modification, addition, deletion, and variation handling of loan repayment schedules with different configurations (declining balance, flat interest type, equal principal, etc.). The tests interact with the REST API endpoints, verify schedule calculations, and validate variations to ensure correct functionality.

classes.name: VariableInstallmentsIntegrationTest
classes.description: A collection of integration test cases for validating variable installment schedule functionalities including creation, modification, variation handling, and schedule validation across different interest types and configurations within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured, sets up request and response specifications, and prepares the helper for loan transactions.

methods.name: testVariableLoanProductCreation
methods.description: Tests the creation of a loan product with variable installment configuration and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testLoanProductCreation
methods.description: Creates a loan product without variable configuration and verifies the setting.

methods.name: testDeleteInstallmentsWithDecliningBalanceEqualInstallments
methods.description: Tests deletion of installments for loans with declining balance interest, ensuring schedule updates correctly.

methods.name: addCollaterals
methods.description: Helper method to add collateral details to collect collateral data for loan applications.

methods.name: assertAfterSubmit
methods.description: Verifies that the server-provided schedule matches the expected schedule after submitting variations.

methods.name: testAddInstallmentsWithDecliningBalanceEqualInstallments
methods.description: Tests adding variable installments on a loan with declining balance interest, asserting schedule correctness.

methods.name: testModifyInstallmentWithDecliningBalanceEqualInstallments
methods.description: Tests modifying installment amounts for a loan with declining balance interest.

methods.name: testAllVariationsDecliningBalancewithEqualInstallments
methods.description: Tests all variation operations (delete, modify, add) on declining balance loans.

methods.name: testAllVariationsDecliningBalancewithEqualPrincipal
methods.description: Tests all variation operations with equal principal configurations.

methods.name: testModifyDatesWithDecliningBalanceEqualInstallments
methods.description: Tests date modification variations on declining balance loans.

methods.name: testDeleteInstallmentsWithInterestTypeFlat
methods.description: Tests deletion of installments on a flat interest rate loan.

methods.name: testAddInstallmentsWithInterestTypeFlat
methods.description: Tests adding installments on a flat interest rate loan.

methods.name: testModifyInstallmentsWithInterestTypeisFlat

methods.name: testAllVariationsWithInterestTypeFlat
methods.description: Tests all variation operations on a flat interest rate loan.

methods.name: testModifyDatesWithInterestTypeFlat
methods.description: Tests date modifications on flat interest rate loans using variations.
